message: I remember the last big storm that rolled through our town, and I was caught completely off guard. This time, I decided to be the prepared one. I stocked up on snacks, filled the bathtub with water, and even had a flashlight ready to go. It felt good to be the one calmly sipping tea while others scrambled around. Who knew preparedness could feel so cozy? Have you ever been the one ready for a storm?
